title: NASA-UAP-D019, Gemini 5 Technical Debriefing, Part I, 1965
doc_notes: This is a technical debriefing transcript for the Gemini 5 mission, which contains a brief mention of an unexplained sound reported by the crew. / This document is a technical debriefing transcript for the Gemini 5 mission; it contains no reports of UAP or anomalous encounters.

encounters.summary: Astronauts reported hearing a 'ding' sound on the hatch twice, which they initially suspected was a micrometeorite impact, though they later considered it might be metal cooling.
encounters.quote: something dinged the hatch. Just bigger than heck - dinged.
